sentences.text: That completes Deck General and Safety.
A few final habits separate professionals from amateurs.
Keep a log of every trip: passengers, weather, incidents and maintenance.
Keep your credential, medical certificate and drug-testing enrollment current.
Carry commercial charter insurance, since recreational policies usually exclude paying passengers.
Use a pre-departure checklist every single trip.
And above all, know your limits and your boat’s limits, and cancel when conditions exceed them.
Next, take the lesson check, then the Deck General quiz, until you’re scoring eighty percent or better.
